function.name: resolve_entity
function.description: Look up the real URI(s) for a name the user mentioned (a species, a place, an organization, ...) via full-text search over rdfs:label. Returns ranked candidates with all their labels and match scores. Call it for every named entity before you write a query, and use the returned URI in the query instead of matching the name as text. Several names: one call per name, all in the same message.

term.description: The name to look up, as one entity (not a whole phrase), e.g. 'Achillea millefolium' or 'Jena'.

type.description: Optional class to narrow results, matched by the class' local name, e.g. 'dwc:Organism' or 'schema:City'.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of candidates to return (default 5).
